name: Crystal Lake keeps a single Worldforged Defias Cowl pickup (#8871)
contract: A static replay of the module's catalog pass (2026_09_16_00) alongside the realm-map pass (2026_09_23_05) suggested two Defias Cowl spawns 4.1 yd apart in Crystal Lake, Elwynn: guid 6901068 from the catalog pass and guid 6940336 authored in game. The realm-map pass wipes every worldforged_pickup spawn in guid blocks 6900001-6939999 and 6940001-6999999 before re-inserting its own set, which deletes 6901068 (in the first block) without ever re-adding it; only guid 6940336 survives. The gameplay harness confirms a single spawn in range, so the apparent duplicate is a replay artifact, not a live defect; no SQL change.

steps.label: exactly one Defias Cowl pickup stands in Crystal Lake
